header.title: Y-app
header.heroAlt: Y-app dashboard with hour booking, the latest entries, running projects with progress, my tasks and to-dos
header.label: Business management
header.tagline: Your whole working day on one screen: projects, hours, mail and calendar
header.desc: Y-app is a clear workspace on top of ERPNext. You install it on your own ERPNext site and sign in with your existing account; your data stays where it is.

meta.description: Free, open-source workspace for ERPNext: projects, planning, hours, mail, calendar and invoices in one overview, on your own ERPNext site.
meta.title: Y-app — OpenAEC Foundation

mail.alt: Y-app inbox with messages linked to projects and an open mail showing the link to its project
mail.title: Mail that belongs to a project stays with the project
mail.desc: Your mail arrives in ERPNext and Y-app sorts it by project, customer, quotation or invoice. A colleague can find the whole conversation, even when you are away.

planning.alt: Y-app planning board showing this week's tasks as bars per employee
planning.title: See at a glance who is working on what
planning.desc: The planning board puts each employee's tasks on a timeline, per week or across several weeks. Filter by company or department, or switch to a kanban board.

projecten.alt: Y-app project list with an open project: customer, project manager, progress, links and tasks
projecten.title: Everything about a project on one page
projecten.desc: Customer, project manager, progress and timeline at the top; below them the tasks, hours, invoices and planning. No more searching through separate lists in ERPNext.

uren.alt: Y-app time tracking with the booking form and this week's hours per day and project
uren.title: Book your hours in seconds
uren.desc: Pick a project and task, press Now and your entry is in. Your week is shown on the right, so a forgotten day stands out. As an employer you approve timesheets in the same place.

agenda.alt: Y-app week calendar with meetings, tasks and the sources and colleagues you can switch on and off
agenda.title: Meetings, tasks and leave in one calendar
agenda.desc: The calendar shows your meetings next to your tasks, leave requests and, if you like, your hours. Add a colleague's calendar to find a time together.

notice.text: Alpha version: many modules are still in development. Try it on a test site first.

whatsnew.label: New in v0.40.0
whatsnew.title: Y-app as an app on your own site
whatsnew.desc: The first version you install on ERPNext yourself. Y-app now runs on the same site as your data, with your existing login and permissions.

install.q: Do I need to install anything?
install.a: Yes, on the server: Y-app is an app for an existing ERPNext 16 site. Your administrator installs it with bench get-app and install-app (see the README). You then open it in the browser under /y-next and sign in with your ERPNext account. There is no public demo yet.

price.a: Nothing. Y-app is open source under the MIT licence. You only pay for hosting ERPNext, if you don't do that yourself.

save.a: Simply in your ERPNext database. Y-app reads and writes through ERPNext's standard API; there is no separate database, no separate account and no external server.

systems.q: Which systems does it run on?
systems.a: In any modern browser, including tablets and phones. The server needs Frappe 16 and ERPNext 16; nothing more.

erpnext.a: Yes. Y-app is a different, simpler front end for ERPNext. All your projects, hours and invoices live in ERPNext; Y-app makes them easier to use.

roles.a: No. Y-app follows ERPNext roles and permissions. An employee sees their own tasks, hours and leave; an employer also sees finance, approvals and staff.

office.q: Can I edit Word and Excel files with it?
office.a: Not yet in version 0.40.0. The development version already has Calc and Writer for .xlsx and .docx, plus Open CAD Studio, Open Planner Studio and an IFC viewer; they will come in a later release.

hosted.a: Y-app started as a hosted service in which you link several ERPNext environments. That version is not distributed publicly. You install the open version on this page on your own ERPNext site; get in touch if you want help with the installation.

frappe.desc: An installable app for Frappe 16 and ERPNext 16, with its own doctypes, fields and permissions.

react.desc: The interface is built with React, TypeScript and Vite and ships pre-built; no Node needed on the server.

tailwind.desc: Styling with Tailwind; the interface adapts to desktop, tablet and phone.

api.desc: Reads and writes with the signed-in user's session; ERPNext permissions stay in charge.

jmap.desc: Optional link to a mail server such as Stalwart for calendars, invitations and out-of-office.

mit.desc: Open source under the MIT licence. Development happens in Y-app-ERPNext, releases are in y_next.
